integrity: The general statement is proved algebraically. Finite exhaustive computations independently check the prime-submodule criterion, graph construction, twin-cell sizes, quotient automorphisms in ranks two and three, and the explicit collision; no finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to faithful finite semisimple modules over finite products of fields with the full prime spectrum. The 2014 foundational full text was not available in the lawful open route inspected; later full text and the 2018 related paper were inspected. The graph signature does not determine field orders and vector-space dimensions separately.
title: Semisimple module Zariski graphs remember exactly the coordinate subspace-count signature
